posts.content:
What an inspiring and energizing couple of days last week in Madrid at #VeevaSummitEU! 

⭐ I’d like to once again congratulate our well-deserving Safety Zone heroes - Rinat Lifshitz-Shovali and Efrat Sabag-Buchnik from Teva Pharmaceuticals and Jeroen van Doorn from MSD.

🙏 I also want to extend a sincere thank you to our speakers for sharing their candid experiences, accomplishments, and lessons learned (in speaking order) – Jeroen van Doorn from MSD, Johanna Strandell from Camurus, Aniket Agarwal from Sandoz, Olga Panek-Białkowska from MSD, Sabura Matthews MBA, BSN, RN, CC from Takeda, Ellen Ravn Englev from Novo, and Martina Binelli from Chiesi.

From a Veeva perspective, we were thrilled to share our progress and plans for...
1) helping customers establish a high-quality data foundation through seamless connections to Veeva EDC, ClinOps, RIM, Medical and Quality applications, 
2) maximizing efficiencies through our suite of applications, Veeva Connections, and advanced automation including AI, and 
3) most importantly, being a transparent and trusted partner to all of our customers.  

Looking forward to #VeevaSummitUS in Boston in September!
